name: Helix
description: A coil climbing the canvas, the near side of each loop large and bright. Set Layers to the number of strands: 1 is a spring, 2 a double helix (DNA), more a twisted rope.
author: @swiftner

formulas.x: x = cos(tx * TAU * 3 + l * TAU / layers) * {x:120}
formulas.scaleX: scaleX = sin(tx * TAU * 3 + l * TAU / layers) * 12
formulas.scaleY: scaleY = sin(tx * TAU * 3 + l * TAU / layers) * 12
formulas.opacity: opacity = 70 + sin(tx * TAU * 3 + l * TAU / layers) * 30
